paper_type.evidence_quote: About 100 energy audits related to rubber processing production sites have been analysed

level_3b.evidence_quote: energy efficiency potential of the rubber manufacturing industry in Italy

stage1.notes: Sector is rubber manufacturing (NACE C22.1); batch/discrete moulding & vulcanisation, not on closed continuous-process list. Steel/pulp&paper/oil refinery appear only as literature mentions.

multi_site.evidence_quote: the totality of audits related to sites of large or energy-intensive companies

type_of_organisation.evidence_quote: the manufacture of rubber products and the production of tyres

ems_standard.evidence_quote: EnPIs have been introduced by the ISO 50001:2018 standard

evidence_quote: According to Article 8 of the EED, since 2015, large companies have been obliged to carry out an energy audit
Pursuant to Article 8 of Legis. D.102/2014, by the deadline of December 2019, 11,172 energy audits of production sites
Energy performance indicators were calculated as specific consumption (total, electric or thermal), having the energy driver as the denominator
A regression analysis was performed for each EnPI, and the evaluation was conducted using two statistical parameters, namely R2 and p-value
